title: Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion for Trustworthy Multi-Omics Multimodal Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2607.20742v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal learning is a robust approach to improve predictive performance in applications such as medical prognosis. However, the clinical applicability of models that use multimodal learning is hampered by their poor performance under noisy or uninformative data streams. Present fusion approaches often lack robust mechanisms for the dynamic assessment of data quality and for the provision of a trustable confidence score on the final prediction. This dissuades their deployment in safety-critical settings. To address these limitations, we introduce Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion (ACE), a novel framework to enhance the trustworthiness of multimodal fusion models. ACE first enhances the multimodal space by generating new, complementary modalities from intra-modality correlations. translated_title: 面向可信多组学多模态融合的自适应置信度加权扩展
translated_abstract: 多模态学习是提升医学预后等应用中预测性能的一种稳健方法。然而，采用多模态学习的模型在噪声或无信息数据流下表现不佳，这阻碍了其临床适用性。现有的融合方法通常缺乏用于动态评估数据质量以及为最终预测提供可信置信度分数的稳健机制，这阻碍了它们在安全关键场景中的部署。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了自适应置信度加权扩展，这是一种旨在增强多模态融合模型可信度的新型框架。ACE首先通过从模态内相关性中生成新的互补模态来增强多模态空间，然后采用双层置信度机制：（1）在融合前根据可靠性自适应地重新加权所有模态，（2）估计一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出自适应置信度加权扩展（ACE）框架，通过从模态内相关性生成互补模态，并利用双层置信度机制在融合前根据可靠性自适应重加权各模态，从而提升多组学多模态融合模型在噪声数据下的可信度。
en_tdlr: Proposes Adaptive Confidence-weighted Expansion (ACE), a framework that generates complementary modalities from intra-modality correlations and employs a dual-level confidence mechanism to adaptively reweigh modalities by reliability before fusion, enhancing the trustworthiness of multi-omics multimodal fusion models under noisy data.
